entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: Era in Dominaria's history beginning with Freyalise's World Spell, also called the Flood Age or Age of Storms.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Thaw took place.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker whose World Spell began the Thaw.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent flooded and split into an archipelago during the Thaw.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Defeated at the end of the Ice Age.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Kingdom formed from Kjeldor and Balduvia.

entities.name: Fyndhorn elves
entities.description: Elves forced by the Flooding to migrate to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: New home of the Fyndhorn elves.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: City hit by plague and destroyed by Soldev's machines.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: Creator of machines that rose against their masters.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: Cult led by Heidar that tried to undo the Thaw.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Leader of the Cult of Rimewind.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: Order finally defeated after the Cult of Rimewind's failure.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who founded the Tolarian Academy, ending the Thaw.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Usurped power in Madara during the Empty Quarter.

events.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell, beginning the Thaw.
events.quote: began with the casting of the World Spell by the planeswalker

events.summary: Floods split Terisiare into an archipelago; plague spreads and Soldev's machines destroy Krov.
events.quote: Soldev 's machines rose against their masters, destroying the once-great city

events.summary: The Cult of Rimewind fails to undo the Thaw; New Argive secures control and the Order of Stromgald is defeated.
events.quote: tried to halt and undo the Thaw with their ice magic but ultimately failed

events.summary: Urza founds the Tolarian Academy, ending the Thaw and starting the War with Phyrexia.
events.quote: the Thaw era ended when Urza founded the Tolarian Academy
